upstream.notes: sources.json lists the PDFs; check_upstream.py HEADs each one and compares the ETag / Last-Modified it saw last time. No PDF is downloaded unless a validator moved.

notes: All US Government work, so hosting it is free of licence trouble. Every source URL in sources.json is marked "verified": false until a human has opened it and confirmed it is the right document from the right publisher; build_pdf_pack.py refuses to build until then.
